title: Pick the meeting that ends first: it leaves the most room for the rest
caption: Five meetings sorted by end time. A meeting is chosen when it starts at or after the end of the last chosen one.

frames.text: [1, 3] ends first. Take it: nothing can end earlier, so it leaves the most room.
[2, 4] starts at 2, before the last chosen end 3. It overlaps [1, 3]: skip.
[3, 5] starts at 3, exactly when [1, 3] ends. It fits: take it.
[0, 7] starts long before 5: skip. It's the meeting that would have blocked everything.
[5, 8] starts at 5: take it. Three meetings, the maximum.
